quest.title: The Day the Sword Departs
quest.description: Sun Yu seems to be preparing to depart Liyue Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Traveler, thank goodness you're here. I almost thought you wouldn't be back today.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Today is the day I depart from Liyue Harbor. I have troubled you so much before... I have to thank you properly.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Ahem... I was just thinking about what to say after seeing you.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Now it's time for me to actually talk, I somehow don't even remember any of the words... Look at me, making a fool of myself even now, haha.

choices.text: Don't worry about it. I'm sure we'll meet again soon.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Really? Haha, that's wonderful news! I'll show you around when you get there!

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Well, I actually still have one last favor to ask. You have a Kamera, right? Do you mind taking a picture for me?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: A sailor told me that it's best to keep a picture of your hometown with you when you are traveling abroad.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: But I don't own a Kamera, so maybe you'd be kind enough to help me out.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: P—Pose!? I—It's about the scenery behind me!

choices.text: I'll pay you a visit in Fontaine sometime.

talks.objective: Take a photo of Sun Yu

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. This picture is just perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's finally time to go. When I hear people say things like "A great man is ready to realize his aspiration anywhere," or "It is better to travel ten thousand miles than to read ten thousand books," I always feel so encouraged and inspired...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: But when it is me who's finally about to set out, I don't feel encouraged or inspired at all. All I want to do is to stay here for a little longer...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Traveler, do you think I can find what I'm looking for during this journey?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Hahaha... I mean, what am I even looking for? Do I even know it myself?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Right, it's about time. I'm going to meet up with that merchant. Please, Traveler, take these as your reward.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Que'er... She's not here after all...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: So... you are saying it's all up to fate.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Traveler, I'm counting on you to take the picture for me.
